questions.question: Six students Jason, Tushar, Anand, Stacey, Steven and Max are sitting around a circular table facing the centre. Jason is sitting third to the right of Tushar. Anand is sitting second to the left of Jason. Steven is an immediate neighbour of Anand and Jason. Max is sitting to the immediate right of Jason. Stacey is to the immediate left of Tushar. Who is sitting between Max and Steven?
questions.solution:
Six students J**ason, Tushar, Anand, Stacey, Steven and Max** are sitting around a circular table facing the centre.

1. Jason is sitting third to the right of Tushar.

2. Anand is sitting second to the left of Jason.

3. Steven is an immediate neighbour of Anand and Jason.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/48e15da547bc5059bb0f96346b3da53dae8914cc9a17ecd25bbfdc426c836141.png] 

4. Max is sitting to the immediate right of Jason.

5. Stacey is to the immediate left of Tushar.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/83c28485ca48cf994cca76b197e1a52639b38e6766ac79e94cca1aa33ab0fce6.png] 

Clearly, Jason is sitting between Max and Steven.

Hence, '**Jason**' is the correct answer.

questions.question:
Three statements are given followed by three conclusions numbered I, II and III. Assuming the statements to be true, even if they seem to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

**Statements**:

All chocolates are biscuits.

All chips are biscuits.

All biscuits are potatoes.

**Conclusions:**

I. All chips are potatoes.

II. All potatoes are chocolates.

III. Some potatoes are chips.

options.text: Only conclusions I and II follow
Only conclusions II and III follow
Only conclusions I and III follow

questions.solution:
The least possible Venn diagram is: 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d55e9e5d741dc9db0a3755aa67a9dc3b9ee05e6f1cd55b32e4001d079a9e28f4.png] 

Conclusions:

I. All chips are potatoes. → **Follows** (As, All chips are biscuits and All biscuits are potatoes)

II. All potatoes are chocolates. → Does not follow (As, All chocolates are biscuits and All biscuits are potatoes → Some potatoes are chocolates)

III. Some potatoes are chips. → **Follows** (As, All chips are biscuits and All biscuits are potatoes)

Hence, '**Only conclusions I and III follow**' is the correct answer.

questions.question:
Select the option that is related to the third word in the same way as the second word is related to the first word.

(The words must be considered as meaningful English words and must not be related to each other based on the number of letters/number of consonants/vowels in the word)

Extra : inadequate :: Appear : ?
questions.solution:
The logic followed here is:

**Logic:** Words are antonyms of each other.

 
• Extra : inadequate → Extra is antonym of inadequate.

Similarly,

 
• Appear : ? → Appear is antonym of disappear.

Hence, '**Disappear**' is the correct answer.
